title: HarnessX:历史最佳验收门(移植)
note: 历史最佳验收门：默认 HG_HARNESSX_REGRESSION_TOLERANCE=0.0，候选经成本项调整后的分数相对历史最佳退步超过容忍度时，复制最佳轮的完整状态树，并用 incumbent_round 明确保留该轮；回滚不调用编辑模型。通过数噪声护栏默认关闭，可用旧环境变量显式启用。门在下一次方法调用时验收刚测完的候选；状态未暂存时只记录版本选择并停止。上游 shipping validator 的运行时和 journal 检查仍未移植。

deviations.what: Rollback restores the staged historical-best tree and declares incumbent_round, but grading is delayed until the next method call.
deviations.why: recipe/gaia_evolver/run.py:802-820 grades and restores inside the upstream loop. This port grades history[-1] on entry using only finite platform-measured scores, copies the best snapshot with editor.apply_edits and uses a single-step editor.report_many selection. Unmeasured/missing scores are not read as zero. The restore consumes a platform submission; a final candidate is ungated if the budget ends before another invocation. If the best snapshot is absent from states/index.json, the port records incumbent_round but cannot physically restore it, stops, and makes no editor call.

deviations.what: The upstream shipping validator is not executed; version selection alone does not implement its preflight checks.
deviations.why: harnessx/meta_harness/validate_workflow.py:909-933 requires HarnessConfig YAML canonicalization and structural changesets, processor hook-mutation contract checks, synthetic-task replay in the HarnessX runtime, and journal/memo novelty and evidence checks. The port edits generic harness trees and has no integration with those HarnessX engine objects or memo/journal artifacts. Platform candidate validation and subsequent scoring are available, but do not implement that workflow.

deviations.what: The brief requires stricter default regression handling than the local upstream source.
deviations.why: The local recipe/gaia_evolver/run.py:463-475 actually defaults regression tolerance to 0.03; :1222-1236 exempts passed-count deltas below 3. As explicitly required by the fix brief, HG_HARNESSX_REGRESSION_TOLERANCE defaults to 0.0 and HARNESSX_PASS_COUNT_NOISE_THRESHOLD defaults to 0 (disabled), so any score regression reverts even without counts. A positive count threshold opts into the upstream noise policy. HARNESSX_TOLERANCE remains a fallback only when the HG variable is absent. Malformed, nonfinite or negative tolerance falls back to 0.0. These defaults were specified, not tuned against scores.

deviations.what: The optional cost penalty uses platform tokens rather than upstream USD.
deviations.why: recipe/gaia_evolver/run.py:1218-1221 uses round_cost in USD. _round_cost instead reads cost[HARNESSX_COST_FIELD], default harness_tokens, falling back to method_generation_tokens and then zero. The relative-cost arithmetic is preserved; cost_weight defaults to 0.0, so the proxy has no effect unless enabled.

deviations.what: The optional passed-count guard has a legacy aggregate fallback and accepts breaches with unavailable counts.
deviations.why: Upstream recipe/gaia_evolver/run.py:1225 always has binary passed counts. _passed uses platform n_passed when present, otherwise rounds score times the available sampling task count, which is approximate for fractional scores. With a positive noise threshold and no count, _gate_decision accepts without updating best. The default disabled count guard does not exempt these regressions.

deviations.what: Edit generation uses the shared editor, with JSON pre-registration rather than the resident HarnessX meta-agent and journal workflow.
deviations.why: main delegates accepted-round proposals to editor.ask using HARNESSX_SYSTEM and records _preregistration fields plus lever validity. It does not run HarnessX evolve orchestration, journal prediction grading or the novelty/evidence workflow. This port tests an adapted acceptance rule, not a reproduction of the upstream scores.
